text: The people drawer. Doctors for children, skin, eyes and bones: paediatrician, dermatologist, ophthalmologist, orthopaedist. A lover of mankind is a philanthropist; a hater of mankind, a misanthrope. One who hates women: a misogynist. One who knows everything: omniscient. A lover of books: a bibliophile. One who eats human flesh: a cannibal.
